descriptions.d10d_rgb5a3_tile_801d8034: Convert the 4x4 block at (x, y) of a 32-bit RGBA image (bytes r, g, b, a; pitch bytes per row) into one big-endian RGB5A3 texture tile with 8-byte rows, clipping edge blocks to the image (unsigned extents, at most 4) and leaving clipped texels untouched. Alpha above 223 gives an opaque texel (1, r5, g5, b5), otherwise a translucent one (0, a3, r4, g4, b4).
